title: ELI5 Why are global index trackers so heavily US weighted and yet considered diverse?
summary: The idea of a global index tracker is to diversify your portfolio - so why are all the most popular ones so heavily weighted to the US market? I understand that the US makes up a majority of the global stock market but my supposedly "low risk" global tracker is 72% US based it worries me that the good ol USA isn't indestructible and that potential major world events affecting the US could destroy 72% of my portfolio?submitted by/u/Curious_Sundae_6627[link][comments]
